37b907b6a2685118.statement: I was parked in the store lot facing the highway, about ten yards from the road. I saw the black car come over the hill from the west and it never slowed down before it went under the trailer.

witness.name: Witness E (Parked Driver in Store Lot)
witness.claim: Parked in the store lot about ten yards from the highway, saw the black car come over the hill from the west and go under the trailer without slowing down.
witness.assumptions: Placed in the parking lot north of the retail store (X = 20.1 m, aligned with bld_retail_store center) and 10 yards (9.14 m) south of the eastbound outside lane center (Z = 0 m), giving Z = 9.1 m (just north of the store front wall at Z = 9.5 m). Set eyeHeight to 1.2 m for a seated car driver and observationTime to 10.43 s (moment of impact when the car went under the trailer).

17accb767695d94b.statement: I was standing on the far side of the highway at the northeast corner of the intersection and watched the black car go straight under the trailer.

witness.name: Witness F (NE Corner Pedestrian)
witness.claim: Standing on the far side of the highway at the northeast corner of the intersection and watched the black car go straight under the trailer.
witness.assumptions: Mapped 'far side of the highway at the northeast corner of the intersection' to [8.5, 0, -40] m, placing the pedestrian north of the westbound lanes of US-27A (which run around z = -31 to -35 m) and just east of the NE 140th Court alignment (x = 0 m). Set observationTime to the moment of impact at t = 10.43 s when the car went under the trailer.

64c2104bad53974e.statement: I was sitting inside the bus shelter in front of the store, on the bench facing the store, when I heard the crash.

witness.name: Witness G (Bus Shelter Sitter)
witness.claim: Sitting on the bench inside the bus shelter in front of the store facing the store when they heard the crash.
witness.assumptions: Mapped 'inside the bus shelter in front of the store' directly to the center of occ_bench_shelter at [8.5, 0, 8.1] m with a seated eye height of 1.2 m. Set observationTime to impact at t=10.43 s ('when I heard the crash') and lookAt to veh_car_a to test line of sight to the collision. [position was inside occ_bench_shelter; moved to its nearest face]
